title: Full Stack Developer-MERN, Nest and NextJs
description:
**Job Overview**

Earthlix Commerce LLP is seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to develop, maintain, and scale a robust e-commerce and procurement platform. The platform includes product and inventory management, advanced search capabilities, barcode generation, role-based access control, supplier management, supply-chain workflows, and Request for Quotation (RFQ) management.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in frontend and backend development, database optimization, search technologies, cloud deployment, and building secure, scalable applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Frontend Development**

* Develop responsive and high-performance web applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Build user-friendly interfaces for product catalogs, inventory, pricing, orders, customers, and procurement modules.
* Implement large data grids with server-side pagination, sorting, filtering, search, virtualization, and optimized rendering.

**2. Backend Development and API Integration**

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Node.js, NestJS, and Express.js.
* Integrate payment gateways and shipping/logistics APIs, including webhooks, order tracking, refunds, cancellations, returns, and inventory synchronization.
* Implement pincode-based serviceability checks and Order Management System (OMS) workflows.
* Develop secure, reliable, and scalable backend architecture.

**3. Database Management and Search Optimization**

* Design and optimize PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases, including schema design, data modeling, indexing, and query optimization.
* Implement Redis for caching, session management, rate limiting, and background job processing.
* Develop advanced search functionality using Elasticsearch or OpenSearch, including SKU search, fuzzy search, autocomplete, faceted filtering, catalog indexing, and relevance tuning.

**4. E-commerce and Procurement Workflows**

* Develop and maintain product catalog, pricing, inventory, order, and customer management modules.
* Implement procurement workflows covering purchase requisitions, purchase orders, approval processes, and Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs).
* Build supplier onboarding and management features, supply-chain tracking, inventory replenishment, and RFQ workflows.
* Implement quotation management, quotation comparisons, negotiation processes, and approval workflows.

**5. Barcode, QR Code and GST Invoicing**

* Develop server-side barcode and QR code generation for SKUs, product labels, shipping packages, and GST invoices.
* Generate barcode and QR code assets in SVG and PNG formats and manage secure storage using AWS S3.
* Implement GST invoicing for CGST, SGST, and IGST, including credit notes and digital tracking QR codes.

**6. Security and Access Control**

* Implement authentication, authorization, JWT-based security, session management, and secure password hashing.
* Develop role-based access control (RBAC), permission management, and audit logging.
* Follow OWASP security best practices and ensure appropriate data protection.

**7. Cloud Deployment and Maintenance**

* Deploy, monitor, and maintain applications on AWS.
* Work with services such as EC2, S3, Route 53, Application Load Balancer (ALB), Auto Scaling Groups, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and ACM.
* Support application scalability, performance optimization, and infrastructure security.
* Troubleshoot production issues and maintain technical documentation.

**8. Testing and Collaboration**

* Write and maintain automated tests using tools such as Jest and Playwright.
* Use Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI for API testing and documentation.
* Work with Git, Docker, Linux, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality software.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Frontend:** React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3

**Backend:** Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, REST API development

**Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, database design, indexing, query optimization

**Caching and Search:** Redis, Elasticsearch or OpenSearch

**Cloud and Security:** AWS deployment, JWT authentication, API authorization, RBAC, OWASP best practices

**Development and Testing Tools:** Git, Docker, Linux, CI/CD, Jest, Playwright, Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* 3–6 years of professional experience in full-stack development.
* Strong hands-on experience with React.js, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript.
* Practical experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, and AWS deployment.
* Good understanding of scalable application architecture, database optimization, API design, and application security.
* Experience developing and maintaining production-grade frontend and backend applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise applications or complex e-commerce platforms.
* Knowledge of inventory management, procurement, supplier management, supply-chain operations, and RFQ workflows.
* Experience with barcode and QR code generation and GST invoicing.
* Hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, including EC2, Route 53, S3, ALB, Auto Scaling Groups, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and ACM.
* Experience working with large SKU catalogs, high-volume data grids, and search optimization.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a technically strong and solution-oriented developer who can independently handle frontend and backend development, optimize application performance, and contribute to building a scalable e-commerce and procurement platform.

Candidates with practical production experience in complex business workflows, database optimization, search technologies, and AWS infrastructure will be preferred.

**Interested candidates are invited to apply with their updated resume and details of their relevant full-stack development experience.**

Pay: From ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Gandhi Nagar, Gujarat

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who can own complex features end-to-end, drive technical decisions, and ensure scalability, security, and performance across the stack. You will work closely with architects, product owners, and junior engineers to deliver high-quality solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Architecture & Design
  

* Design and evolve RESTful API contracts using Swagger/OpenAPI
* Define backend microservices architecture and frontend modular design
* Ensure solutions scale for performance, security, and maintainability

Backend Development
  

* Build and maintain services using Java (8+/17), Spring Boot
* Implement Spring Security with OAuth2/OIDC/JWT
* Design and optimize databases, queries, and indexing strategies
* Implement asynchronous communication using Kafka / RabbitMQ
* Write clean, testable, and production-grade code

Frontend Development
  

* Build scalable UI using React, TypeScript
* Use advanced React patterns (Hooks, Context, React Query/Redux)
* Optimize frontend performance (lazy loading, memoization, CRP optimization)
* Ensure accessibility, responsiveness, and cross-browser compatibility
* Write test cases using jest

DevOps & Cloud
  

* Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/GitLab)
* Containerize applications using Docker and deploy via Kubernetes
* Work with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) for application deployment
* Ensure observability using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools

Quality & Leadership
  

* Drive automated testing across the stack
* Conduct rigorous code reviews and enforce best practices
* Mentor junior developers and guide technical implementations
* Collaborate in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Required Skills (Must-Have)
  
Backend
  

* Strong expertise in Java 8+/17 & Spring Boot
* Spring Security (OAuth2, JWT, OIDC)
* Microservices architecture
* SQL & database optimization

Frontend
  

* Strong hands-on experience with React & TypeScript
* Advanced understanding of hooks, state management
* Experience integrating APIs and handling async workflows

DevOps & System Design
  

* Docker & Kubernetes
* CI/CD pipelines
* Git-based workflows
* Understanding of distributed systems concepts

Nice to Have (Value Add Skills)
  

* Cloud-native architecture experience
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
* React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright
* GraphQL exposure
* WebSockets / real-time UI updates
* Experience working on high-traffic applications
* Prior experience in mentoring or technical leadership roles

**Other Requirements**
